protocol.driver_contract: Use separate a3_additional_diagnostic.py with shared prior 8 whole +36 kernel result book; no retries or continuation. Stop first failed witness/process or timeout, retaining every trace and any science bytes. Aggregate book includes first subset time; additional cap600s, parent2700s. Optimized Python is rejected before parsing inputs. Refusal repeat identity includes admission/refusal reasons, component dimensions and completed per-RHS/component work. Every terminal invocation records attempted/unattempted call counts; budget exhaustion or unattempted cells is incomplete and exits nonzero. End identity checks include the manifest and driver; invocation stores the starting shared-book SHA-256. Successful science files require exact header, shape, typed bank lengths and byte length; refusal requires no science file.
limitations: Sparse q=2048 cases may consume the deadline or refuse; refusal is not a successful measured geometry.

The 600-second cap can leave cells unmeasured; no automatic continuation or evidence-based panel tuning is permitted.

reviewed_exact_arithmetic_math.status: Diagnostic derivation independently reconciled with projection_cost_review; no floating convergence guarantee
reviewed_exact_arithmetic_math.definitions: Per connected component C_ab=w_ab/sqrt(m_a*m_b),u_a=sqrt(m_a/M),v_b=sqrt(m_b/M),beta=||C-u*v^T||_F^2=sum_edges(w_ab/m_a)*(w_ab/m_b)-1. alpha=v_anchor^2. H=diag((I-C^TC)_grounded),hmin=min H,hmax=max H.
reviewed_exact_arithmetic_math.loewner: If0<=beta<1, (1-beta)(I-v*v^T)<=I-C^TC<=I-v*v^T. After grounding and Jacobi scaling: lambda_min>=ell=(1-beta)*alpha/hmax; all except at most one eigenvalue lie in[L=(1-beta)/hmax,U=min(1/hmin,2)].
reviewed_exact_arithmetic_math.cg_bound: Exact arithmetic, k>=1: relative Euclidean residual of the symmetrically Jacobi-preconditioned system (relative to its initial residual) <=2*sqrt(K)*(K-1)*rho^(k-1), K=U/ell,rho=(sqrt(U/L)-1)/(sqrt(U/L)+1). Polynomial annihilates possible lowest outlier and Chebyshev-bounds the remaining cluster. Handle degenerate cluster separately.
reviewed_exact_arithmetic_math.limits: Raw binary64 beta is not an upper enclosure; no rounding or finiteprecision iteration certificate is implemented. All measured additional beta values exceed1, so this bound gives no useful contraction estimate there. Weak/disconnected controls were not reached. No learned small-iteration substitute is authorized. This transformed-system bound is not itself the implementation stopping test or the original-input FE certificate.
reviewed_exact_arithmetic_math.derivation: The constant singular pair gives C=u*v^T+R with R*v=0 and R^T*u=0; ||R||_2^2<=||R||_F^2=beta. Hence delta(I-v*v^T)<=I-C^T*C<=I-v*v^T, delta=1-beta. Grounding leaves the rank-one projector with smallest eigenvalue alpha=v_anchor^2. Jacobi congruence yields lambda_min>=delta*alpha/hmax; rank-one interlacing puts all but at most one eigenvalue above delta/hmax. The grounded Schur matrix is a grounded graph Laplacian, so its Jacobi-normalized upper eigenvalue is at most2, and the upper Loewner bound also gives1/hmin. Choose the CG error polynomial to vanish at the possible lowest eigenvalue and use a degree(k-1) Chebyshev factor on[L,U]. The root factor is bounded by K-1 and conversion from energy error to relative Euclidean residual costs sqrt(K), yielding the stated exact-arithmetic bound. Rounding enclosures and mapping to the actual stopping/certificate metrics remain unresolved.
